title: Beyond the Dirac Delta: Mitigating Diversity Collapse in Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for Versatile Image Generation
abstract: arXiv:2601.12401v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a paradigm for fine-tuning large-scale generative models, such as diffusion and flow models, to align with complex human preferences and user-specified tasks. A fundamental limitation remains \textit{the curse of diversity collapse}, where the objective formulation and optimization landscape inherently collapse the policy to a Dirac delta distribution. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{DRIFT} (\textbf{D}ive\textbf{R}sity-\textbf{I}ncentivized Reinforcement \textbf{F}ine-\textbf{T}uning for Versatile Image Generation), an innovative framework that systematically incentivizes output diversity throughout the on-policy fine-tuning process, reconciling strong task alignment with high generation diversity to enhance versatility essential for applications that demand diverse candidate generations. translated_abstract: 强化学习已成为微调大规模生成模型（如扩散模型和流模型）的一种范式，使其与复杂的人类偏好和用户指定任务保持对齐。然而，一个根本性的局限依然存在，即“多样性坍缩的诅咒”——目标函数的构造与优化景观会固有地将策略坍缩为狄拉克δ分布。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了DRIFT（多样性激励的多功能图像生成强化微调框架），这是一个创新框架，在整个在线策略微调过程中系统性地激励输出多样性，在实现强任务对齐的同时保持高生成多样性，从而增强多功能性，这对于需要多样化候选生成结果的应用场景至关重要。我们从三个代表性视角切入该问题：i) 采样……
tldr: 提出DRIFT框架，通过在强化微调全过程中系统性地激励输出多样性，破解了生成模型强化学习中的“多样性坍缩”难题，实现了强任务对齐与高生成多样性的平衡。
en_tdlr: DRIFT is proposed as an innovative framework that systematically incentivizes output diversity throughout on-policy reinforcement fine-tuning, mitigating the curse of diversity collapse while reconciling strong task alignment with high generation diversity for versatile image generation.
